COMPUTER STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.

2. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

4. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

6. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

7. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

11. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.

12. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

13. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

14. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

15. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.

16. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Central Processing Unit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Computer set up and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Data communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
